resources.string: Voice recordings are sent to your selected provider. Typing, predictions, and swipe input remain local.
Bypass OpenWispr and launch an external voice-input app
Configure OpenWispr voice input before dictating
Modified non-commercial FUTO Keyboard fork by OpenWispr. Voice input uses user-configured network providers and is not an official FUTO release.
Dictate into any text field with the keyboard hidden

Shows a small mic bubble while a text field is focused and the keyboard is hidden. Tap to dictate, tap again to stop, long-press to cancel or hide, drag to move. OpenWispr uses this access only to find the focused text field and insert your dictation; recordings go to your configured speech provider, as with the keyboard mic.
